image-to-ico-converter.formula:
ICO file = 6-byte header + 16 bytes per directory entry + image data
Entry: width(1) height(1) colors(1) reserved(1) planes(2) bpp(2) size(4) offset(4)
Example: 3 sizes (16/32/48) -> header bytes 0-5, entries bytes 6-53, PNG data from byte 54.
Size 256 is stored as 0 in the width/height byte.

You upload a 1000 x 1000 px PNG logo and tick 16, 32, and 48 px.
Each size is rendered square and PNG-encoded: say 1.2 KB, 3.8 KB, and 7.1 KB.
